name: Playwright Flaky Test Debug Pack
purpose: Diagnose flaky or environment-sensitive Playwright test failures with emphasis on locator quality, wait strategy, isolation, and CI behavior.
when_to_use: tests pass locally but fail in CI
UI waits or locators seem unstable
browser automation diagnosis is the primary task
notes: Escalate to workflow.full_default if the task expands into code change recommendations.
Use trace, screenshot, and locator evidence where available.
Keep hypothesis ranking explicit when the failure is intermittent.
